title: The generals of the 1999 Sabbat war
summary: Who led the East Coast offensive.

claims.text: The Sabbat offensive begun in mid-June 1999 took Atlanta, Washington and most cities between; three archbishops led it: Sascha Vykos (newly made archbishop in Washington), Borges (of Miami) and Francisco Polonia (of New York).
Vykos owed much of that success to Parmenides, an Assamite assassin bound to Vykos’s will, and to a mysterious spy called Lucius.
Once stalled in Washington, the three generals began to quarrel among themselves.
